Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper for a Tendermint accountability/debug specification instantiated to a concrete system size. It declares a proposer-selection constant and the state variables used by the underlying Tendermint-style protocol state, then instantiates another module with explicit parameters for one correct process, three faulty processes, a total of four processes, a fault threshold of one, a small value domain, and a bounded maximum round. The only top-level operator in this file is a constant-initialization predicate constraining the proposer mapping to be a function from rounds to all processes; the file itself contains no transition relation, temporal specification, or proof, because those are not syntactically defined here.
